name: @omni/design
description: The Omni Loop design system: the tokens (colours, scale and semantic roles in three themes, from W3C DTCG files) and tokens.css, the fonts, the 16-bit crest logo, the Omni Loop brand, hand-placed pixel sprites and the planet renderer.

scripts.fonts: node --input-type=module -e "import { writeFileSync } from 'node:fs'; import { fontsCss } from './src/fonts.ts'; writeFileSync('fonts.css', fontsCss());"
